description: One project at a glance: whether its agent is connected (the endpoint QualiLoop calls and where it reads traces), whether live traffic is on, and how its tests went over the last days: tests finished and passed (a test passes when none of its conversations has a major problem; a stopped or failed test does not pass), how many ended in each outcome, the pass rate, major and minor problems, and the most common problem categories. Start here for "how is this agent doing".

project.description: The project's number (as the app shows it, e.g. 12 or '#12') or its name. Optional when the organization has one project.
